intro: Section 23.11 covers narrative psychotherapy: its roots, the idea that people live by the stories they tell, the narrative elements of metaphor, plot and character, and narrative psychiatry and its future directions. A dashed box adds early meta-analytic evidence.
objectives: Explain the core ideas of narrative psychotherapy and where they came from.
Describe how metaphor, plot and character are used in therapy.
Describe narrative psychiatry and its future directions.
